item.title: Weak China auto demand sends parts maker Hiroca deeper into North America, Japan
item.summary: Hiroca Holdings reported consolidated revenue of NT$370 million (approx. US$11.5 million) for July, down 17.2% from the previous month and 16.7% from a year earlier. Consolidated revenue for the first seven months of 2026 reached NT$2.89 billion, down 2.07% year-over-year.
